svg.title: This structural family follows from the actual two-tap model: a balanced flag matrix times diag(a0, a1) gives x = |a0|2, y = |a1|2, c = a∗ 0a1. Input-independent mixtures preserve it by Cauchy–Schwarz. Unknown path loss and phase change the coefficients but preserve the family. This is a physical-model admission; finite probes cannot prove exact symmetry or dark-free behavior for an unrestricted device. Use independent identically prepared copies within each trusted-probe batch |0⟩, |1⟩, |+⟩, | + i⟩, with a fixed input-independent reader preparation and stationary pointer probabilities during calibration.
